name: Action Figures
reward: Cash and RP per figure; all 100 unlock the Impotent Rage outfit, a new hairstyle and $50,000.
description: Small superhero and space-themed figurines scattered across the map, many in high or hidden spots.

name: Playing Cards
reward: Casino chips and RP; collecting all 54 unlocks the High Roller outfit plus a Red Dead Online bonus.
description: A full deck of cards hidden around Los Santos and Blaine County, added alongside The Diamond Casino & Resort.

name: Signal Jammers
reward: Destroying all 50 gives $50,000, RP and unlocks Avi Schwartzman as a hacker for The Diamond Casino Heist.
description: Small transmitters mounted on buildings and structures that must be shot or blown up.

name: Movie Props
reward: Cash and RP per prop; delivering all 10 unlocks an alien-themed costume.
description: Stolen film props for producer Solomon Richards, some found lying around and others inside vehicles that must be driven to the studio.

name: LD Organics Product
reward: $1,000 and 1,000 RP per package; all 100 give $100,000 and 100,000 RP, and delivering them to Lamar adds $50,000 plus an LD Organics cap and tee.
description: Packages of Lamar's weed brand hidden around the map.

name: Media Sticks
reward: Each unlocks music for the Media Player; full sets unlock clothing such as the CircoLoco tee.
description: USB sticks with unreleased music, spread across the Los Santos Tuners and The Contract updates.

name: Stunt Jumps
description: Ramp jumps around the map that count as completed when the player lands cleanly through the marked zone.

name: Weapon Components (Crime Scenes)
reward: Finding all five unlocks the Service Carbine and its upgrades.
description: Parts recovered from crime scenes that together assemble a new weapon.

name: Treasure Hunt (Double-Action Revolver)
reward: Unlocks the Double-Action Revolver and a cash reward.
description: A clue trail that starts with a note and leads through several locations to a buried chest.

name: Peyote Plants
description: Seasonal plants that briefly transform the player into an animal when eaten.

name: Snowmen
reward: About $5,000 and 1,000 RP each in recent events; all 25 unlock a Snowman outfit and a cash bonus.
description: Festive snowmen that appear around the map during the winter holiday event and must be destroyed.

name: Jack O' Lanterns
reward: Random treats (cash, RP, health, snacks) or tricks; 10 in a day unlock the Pumpkin Mask and $50,000.
description: Carved pumpkins that appear during the Halloween event, with 10 active per day.

name: UFO Sightings
reward: About $15,000 and 1,000 RP per photo; all of them give $100,000 and Believe Cap variants.
description: UFOs that hover over spots overnight during a Halloween event and must be photographed.

name: Ghosts Exposed
reward: Cash and RP per ghost; the full set unlocks an event clothing or livery reward that changes each year.
description: Ghosts that appear at night during Halloween events and must be photographed before they vanish.

name: Lucky Clovers
reward: All 25 unlock the Lucky Clover Outfit; a rarer Golden Clover unlocks its own outfit.
description: St. Patrick's Day collectibles hidden around the map.

name: Yuanbao
reward: $888 and 888 RP each, with a completion bonus (most recently $88,888).
description: Gold ingots hidden during the Lunar New Year event.

name: Shipwrecks
reward: Roughly $20,000-$25,000 and 2,000 RP per chest; seven collected unlock The Frontier outfit.
description: A daily washed-up chest at one of about 30 coastal wreck sites, findable without special equipment.

name: Hidden Caches
reward: Roughly $7,500-$10,000 and 500 RP each per day.
description: Ten underwater packages spawn each day from a pool of 100 spots; Kosatka sonar reveals them.

name: Treasure Chests
reward: Roughly $15,000-$25,000 and 1,000 RP each (sources vary).
description: Two daily chests on and around Cayo Perico, reached while on the island.

name: Buried Stashes
reward: Cash and RP per stash (around $25,000 by some guides).
description: Two daily dig sites where a metal detector helps locate buried loot.

name: G's Caches
reward: A random amount of cash (about $15,000-$20,000) plus RP, ammo and snacks.
description: A daily package hidden by G inside a search area; grabbing it can attract the police.

name: Stash Houses
reward: The safe can refill supplies for one of your businesses, or pays about $30,000 and RP if you own none.
description: A daily gang hideout to raid; clear the guards, find the safe code and crack it.

name: Street Dealers
reward: They buy drug product carried by the player at a premium.
description: Three dealers appear daily at random spots and buy cocaine, meth, weed or acid, with one usually paying a bonus rate.

name: Junk Energy Skydives
reward: Cash and RP for landing well; gold-medal runs pay the most.
description: Parachute challenges that start from icons around the map, with skydives rotating through the day.

name: LS Tags
reward: $15,000 and 500 RP per billboard; all five in a day add a bonus and the Street Artist outfit.
description: Daily billboards to tag with a spray can, chosen from a pool of 30.

name: Smoke on the Water Product
description: Daily weed product pickups tied to owning the Smoke on the Water dispensary.

name: Wildlife Photography
description: A daily list of three animals to photograph for the LS Tourist Board, available on current-generation versions.

name: Exotic Exports
description: A daily list of ten exotic cars to find on the streets and deliver to the docks.

name: Time Trials
reward: Cash and RP for beating the par time, paid once per weekly rotation.
description: Weekly timed races in three varieties: a standard Time Trial, an HSW Time Trial and an RC Bandito Time Trial.
